einzeiler: Arthur Rizk discusses his work in War Hungry, Summerlands, and metal production.
kurzfassung: Producer and musician Arthur Rizk discusses his journey in underground music, from early noise bands to shaping modern extreme metal. He shares insights on working with Power Trip, Sepultura, Blood Incantation, and Power Trip, alongside Taylor Young and the hosts. The conversation explores production techniques, gear, and the blurred lines between hardcore and metal.
stichpunkte: Growing up in Pennsylvania and discovering extreme music via imported cassette tapes
Early creative outlets in noise and experimental projects like Air Conditioning and Terrorism
Joining War Hungry and the moment Leeway bridged the gap to hardcore for him
Recording Power Trip's breakthrough album and developing his engineering career
Balancing band memberships and production work for bands like Max and Igor Cavalera
Forming Summerlands and Eternal Champion as an extension of his metal passion
Recording Blood Incantation's acclaimed album Absolute Elsewhere at Hansa Studios
Re-recording Cro-Mags' Age of Quarrel and collaborating with Harley Flanagan

clips.text: The guest describes attending chaotic underground noise shows in a former sweatshop basement where crowds engaged in extreme physical violence and threw objects.
The guest learns the exact tally of his official music industry release credits on a popular online database.

clips.hook: Recording in Berlin at Hansa Studios
clips.text: The conversation touches upon recording a major extreme metal record at a legendary historic studio in Germany.

clips.hook: Bonding over R&B and free jazz
clips.text: A veteran hardcore musician shares his surprising appreciation for 1970s R&B tracks while discussing unexpected musical influences.

clips.hook: The accidental invention of drum triggering
clips.text: The discussion covers a legendary producer who accidentally pioneered electronic drum triggering while working with disco music artists.

beschreibung:
We're joined by Pennsylvania's own ARTHUR RIZK! Longtime friend of the show and expert producer/engineer of all things extreme.

Before discussing his work with bands like Blood Incantation, Power Trip, the Cavaleras, Cro-Mags, Kreator (and so many more)... We discuss Arthur's background as the once reluctant guitar player of legendary PA Hardcore band WAR HUNGRY, which lead to him finding his footing in the hardcore community in the early oughts as a young metalhead.

These days Arthur is juggling his time as a musician between COLD WORLD, ETERNAL CHAMPION and SUMERLANDS when he's not manning the board for metal's biggest bands.

We're also joined once again by guest co-host and another modern great in extreme music engineering, our very own Taylor Young. This is a fascinating deep dive into the world of hardcore, metal & punk production with two of the greatest minds currently doing it. Enjoy.
